name: Maia Sandu
summary: Sandu advocates EU accession, democratic institutions, anti-corruption reform and a more resilient economy with stronger social provision. She supports climate action and equal participation for women, and defends restrictions on foreign-financed electoral subversion while maintaining Moldova’s constitutional neutrality.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Her campaign promises a minimum monthly salary of 10,000 lei by 2030.

property-fundamental.rationale: She defends European respect for private property against claims that accession entails confiscation of citizens’ land.

regulate-corporations.rationale: She demands independent audits and disclosure duties for social platforms’ political advertising and content-moderation practices.

cut-welfare.rationale: She promises higher pensions and free school meals rather than reducing social support.

restrict-hate-speech.rationale: She endorses passing draft legislation to deter hate and discriminatory speech.

empower-police-military.rationale: She prioritizes modern defense equipment and stronger air defenses.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: She calls for stronger collective UN cooperation and international mechanisms against cross-border illicit finance.

limit-growth.rationale: Her approach couples economic modernization with sustainable energy and lower emissions rather than limiting growth itself.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: She calls climate action a national priority and commits to a 70 percent emissions reduction from 1990 levels.

state-directs-investment.rationale: She advocates public supplements for young people’s first jobs in strategically important economic fields.

democracy-best.rationale: She describes democracy as a universal ideal and the core value of the Moldovan state.

right-to-secede.rationale: Her proposed Transnistrian settlement preserves Moldova’s sovereignty and internationally recognized territorial integrity.

distinct-gender-roles.rationale: She rejects stereotypes about women’s political place and insists on equal participation based on merit.

patriarchy-structural.rationale: She identifies patriarchal traditions, male-dominated party sponsorship and discriminatory practices as barriers to women.

equal-moral-worth.rationale: She insists law applies to everyone and equal rights and opportunities extend to every Moldovan.

ban-extremist-parties.rationale: She defends court-based exclusion of unconstitutional, foreign-financed parties and successor organizations.

pool-sovereignty.rationale: She advocates completing reforms for full membership of the European Union.

reunify-divided-nation.rationale: She supports union with Romania personally but requires majority consent and currently pursues EU membership instead.

minority-language-support.rationale: She supports multilingual schooling in Gagauzia and including it in the Education Code.

force-to-prevent-secession.rationale: She commits to a peaceful political settlement of the Transnistrian conflict.

sovereign-above-law.rationale: She celebrates powerful people learning that they are subject to the same law as others.

gender-parity-bodies.rationale: She calls for enforcing the rule requiring at least 40 percent of either gender on parliamentary candidate lists.

self-reliance-over-aid.rationale: She explicitly seeks international support for the billions in investment required for climate modernization.

single-official-language.rationale: Although Romanian is the state language, she expressly endorses multilingual education rather than exclusive Romanian schooling.

corporate-influence.rationale: She criticizes private financial interests capturing state institutions and demands their removal.

restrict-foreign-funding.rationale: She defends blocking foreign illicit financing of political proxies and associated fake-media operations.

suppress-opposition.rationale: She defends barring identified Kremlin proxies from elections, while insisting on free media and genuine political rights; the restriction is specific.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: She defends improving Moldova’s military defenses against airspace violations.

stay-neutral-between-blocs.rationale: In 2026 she explicitly says Moldova must respect constitutional neutrality while assisting Ukraine.

no-foreign-bases.rationale: She demands unconditional withdrawal of Russian troops in the name of constitutional neutrality and international law.

anonymous-payments.rationale: She endorses tracing cryptocurrency flows to stop covert electoral financing.

restructure-world-economy.rationale: She seeks international asset-recovery rules to restore wealth extracted from weaker states and make the system fairer.

one-language-many-names.rationale: She says Romanian and the so-called Moldovan language are the same language, and signed the naming law.

women-suffrage.rationale: She explicitly encourages women to seek elected office on equal terms with men.

international-criminal-courts.rationale: She supports the Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine.

notes: Reviewed education and women’s participation, 2021 UN and climate speeches, 2023 language law and minority schooling, 2024 campaign proposals, 2025 political-party restrictions and 2026 defense/EU/reunification statements. Downloaded full Venice Commission, UN and EU-summit speeches and searched across themes; checked all 490 statements and remaining nulls. Restrictions on foreign-funded parties are recorded with low confidence on the broader suppression proposition because she simultaneously defends genuine association and expression. No assumption that every opposition party is unlawful. EU integration is not evidence for legalizing same-sex marriage or prostitution; verified disinformation context. No explicit general marriage, abortion, gender-identity or criminal-justice platform found. Neutrality remains a stated constitutional commitment; cooperation with NATO does not itself establish support for joining NATO. Private-property protection is not an absolute ban on expropriation. Language-law signing does not prove ethnic exclusivity. No living-person inferences.
